title: M4 Gun
description:
-Its a mod that has an m4 gun ; bullets , new structure thats 1/1000 chance ; new villager trader that needs a titanium block to work ; titanium ore and ingot ; a car ; advancements that are : Car age ; Titanium Age
Check my channel for updates : Anas_Jr
body:
Its a complete m4 gun mod with 3d models ores etc... go explore caves to find the titanium ore to craft the gun the recipe will unlock itself once you obtain the ore ; Its in the overworld so noone goes looking for it in the nether or end and starts complaining , you also need bullets to use it.  

Show some support by liking and sharing this mod with friends please !!!  

-Fixed lots of broken stuff "3d models,textures etc."  
-Added cooldown to the gun 'its a temporary change until i find a better solution to stop people from just spamming'.  
-Added A CAR; YES A CAR  that can be crafted .  
-Added a Structure that is 1/1000 chance that contains the car inside it .  
-Added two new advancments : Titanium Age . Car Age.  
-Added titanium block.  
-Added a villager merchant  'Needs titanium block that can be crafted by 9 titanium ingots'  
-Added Titanium Armour .
